thread:
ryan: Quick follow-up from today's outage — capturing remediation ownership and timelines in one thread. Root cause summary: cloud auth provider instability -> cascading timeouts to model-registry -> some services didn't hit their fallback. I want explicit owners, due dates, and a note on recurring patterns.

ryan: Proposed action list (please confirm owners):
1) Multi-region auth fallback + short-circuiting on token refresh failures (owner: elena) — target: 2026-04-12
2) Model-registry read-path hardening: cached fallback + retry/backoff tuning (owner: samir) — target: 2026-04-05
3) Recurring-incident detector: log-based rule + alert to SRE when pattern matches (owner: katie) — target: 2026-04-20
4) Runbook update: explicit circuit-break and degrade-to-local-model for <service list> (owner: jordan) — target: 2026-03-30
5) Vendor SL/contract review + escalation playbook (owner: ryan) — target: 2026-04-15

elena: I'll take #1. Plan: implement region failover for auth calls + client-side short-circuit after X 5xxs. Opening PR today, will tag @ryan and @ops-bot.

samir: Taking #2. Proposed approach: 5m TTL cache in front of registry reads + blobstore fallback for older model manifests. Will draft design doc and post link here. Need infra help for namespace-mirroring.

katie: I'll own #3. Detector idea: alert when `sum(auth_errors{job="auth"}) / sum(auth_calls{job="auth"}) > 0.05` over 3m and when `model_registry_5xx / registry_calls > 0.02` correlated. Will add to pager rules as a non-pager first, then escalate.

jordan: On runbook. I'll add explicit steps: check vendor status, switch to cached manifests, flip circuit breaker, and temporary routing to dedicated region. Also add a checklist to verify fallbacks in staging weekly.

ryan: I created JIRA tickets: RW-ENG-1245 (#1), RW-ENG-1246 (#2), RW-ENG-1247 (#3), RW-ENG-1248 (#4). Please paste JIRA links after you create PRs.

samir: small question — for the cached fallback, do we want eventual consistency window documented? propose docs note: `cache_ttl = 5m` and `stale_while_revalidate = 30m`. @elena any concerns w/ token expiry UX?

elena: fine with that TTL. We'll surface a degraded response header so clients can choose to retry.

katie: For recurring patterns, I'll also add a weekly query that checks incidence of vendor-auth spikes over past 90 days so we can flag vendors with trends.

ryan: Ops-bot, can you attach the incident ID and logs to the JIRA tickets and link this thread?

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0472 created and attached to RW-ENG-1245..1248. Logs: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-0472.zip

jordan: Quick note: add an explicit fallback test to the release checklist — simulate auth 500s and model-registry 503s in CI smoke. I'll add a test case.

samir: FYI I'll need a 1h sync with infra for the blobstore perms. @elena can you join?

elena: yep — ping me in calendar, morning PST works.

ryan: Owners — please confirm acceptance of tasks here by EOD. If you need more time or blockers, say so. I'll run a weekly follow-up until all items are closed. :eyes: :thumbsup:

elena: confirmed. PR soon. :thumbsup:

samir: confirmed, scheduling infra sync.

katie: confirmed — detector work in my backlog, will post follow-up RFC by Friday.

jordan: confirmed, updating runbook now.

ryan: Thanks — I'll add a recurring incident retrospective slot to next week's SRE sync to watch for patterns.

elena: also putting a note in Dedicated customers list to email if they see model degradations — helps with support ops.

ryan: Great. Closing thread when all JIRAs are green.
